class.name: agrobot_controllers/YawHeadingController
class.description: Heading-hold: integrates the commanded yaw rate into a target heading and corrects the angular velocity with a PD(I) loop on the IMU yaw. Head of the drive chain.

class.name: agrobot_controllers/FuzzyGainScheduler
class.description: Fuzzy (error, error-rate) scheduler that retunes the wheel PID gains on the motor controller and passes the velocity command through to the base controller.
